title: Read the timing phases of one request
purpose: Name the seven timing phases of one request in order and say what makes each phase grow.
sequence_reason: The Timing tab lists phases in a fixed order, and a change in conditions grows some phases and not others, so motion shows the cause.
summary: The Network panel Timing tab splits one request into Queueing, Stalled, DNS Lookup, Initial connection, Request sent, Waiting (TTFB) and Content Download. A slow server grows Waiting, Slow 4G throttling grows Waiting and Content Download, and a repeat visit with the cache on loads the file from the browser cache.
explanation: Read the longest phase first: it tells you where the time goes. The millisecond values in this walkthrough are example numbers, not measurements.

learning_check.question: Waiting (TTFB) is long and Content Download is short. Where do you look first?
learning_check.answer: At the server: Waiting is one round trip plus server processing time, so a long Waiting with a short download points at server time.

scenes.heading: One request, seven phases
scenes.narration: Open the Network panel, click one request, and open the Timing tab. It splits the request into phases.

scenes.heading: The phases, in order
scenes.narration: The phases run in this order: Queueing, Stalled, DNS Lookup, Initial connection, Request sent, Waiting, and Content Download.

scenes.heading: Queueing and Stalled are waits
scenes.narration: Queueing and Stalled are waits. The request waits for higher-priority requests, a free connection, or disk cache space.

items: HTTP/1.0 and 1.1 allow six connections per origin
The browser waits for disk cache space

scenes.heading: Find the server, then connect
scenes.narration: DNS Lookup finds the server IP address. Initial connection covers the TCP handshakes and the SSL negotiation.

items: DNS Lookup: find the server IP address
Initial connection: TCP handshakes and SSL negotiation
Request sent: the browser sends the request

scenes.heading: A slow server grows Waiting
scenes.narration: Waiting, or TTFB, is one round trip plus server time. In this example, a slow server makes Waiting the longest bar.

scenes.heading: Throttling grows the network phases
scenes.narration: Now set Throttling to Slow 4G. Waiting and Content Download grow, because each round trip and each byte is slower.

visual.verdict: Example numbers: the network phases grow

scenes.heading: Disable cache on or off
scenes.narration: Disable cache makes a first visit. Turn it off and reload: a repeat visit loads files from the browser cache instead.

left.label: Disable cache on
items: The request goes to the server

right.label: Disable cache off
items: The file comes from the browser cache

scenes.heading: Read the longest phase first
scenes.narration: Read the longest phase first. Long Waiting points at the server, long Content Download at size or network, long Queueing at competition.

items: Long Waiting (TTFB): look at the server
Long Content Download: file size or network
Long Queueing: too many requests compete
